title: Saul Kills the Priests

questions.question: Where did David flee to after Gath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:1 (ESV): “David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam.”

questions.question: Who joined David at the cave?
options: Everyone who was in distress, in debt, or bitter in soul
questions.correctAnswer: Everyone who was in distress, in debt, or bitter in soul
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:2 (ESV): “And everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, gathered to him.”

questions.question: Who told Saul that Ahimelech helped David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:9 (ESV): “Then answered Doeg the Edomite... ‘I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech...’”

questions.question: What did Saul order regarding the priests of Nob?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:17 (ESV): “And the king said to the guard... ‘Turn and kill the priests of the Lord...’”

questions.question: Who was the only priest to escape the massacre?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:20 (ESV): “But one of the sons of Ahimelech... named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.”

questions.question: Where did David take his parents for safety?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:3 (ESV): "And David went from there to Mizpah of Moab. And he said to the king of Moab, 'Please let my father and my mother stay with you...'"

questions.question: Which prophet told David to leave the stronghold and go to Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:5 (ESV): "Then the prophet Gad said to David, 'Do not remain in the stronghold...'"

questions.question: How many men were with David at Adullam?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:2 (ESV): "...And he became captain over them. And there were with him about four hundred men."

questions.question: Who refused to kill the priests when Saul ordered it?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:17 (ESV): "...But the servants of the king would not put out their hand to strike the priests of the LORD."

questions.question: How many priests did Doeg kill?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:18 (ESV): "...And he killed on that day eighty-five persons who wore the linen ephod."

questions.question: Saul accused his servants of creating a conspiracy because none of them ______ to him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:8 (ESV): "...and there is none of you who is sorry for me or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me..."

questions.question: Where was Saul sitting when he addressed his servants?
options: Under the tamarisk tree on the height at Gibeah
questions.correctAnswer: Under the tamarisk tree on the height at Gibeah
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:6 (ESV): "...Saul was sitting at Gibeah under the tamarisk tree on the height with his spear in his hand..."

questions.question: What else did Doeg destroy in Nob besides the priests?
options: Men, women, children, infants, oxen, donkeys, and sheep
questions.correctAnswer: Men, women, children, infants, oxen, donkeys, and sheep
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:19 (ESV): "And Nob, the city of the priests, he put to the sword; both man and woman..."

questions.question: Ahimelech defended David, saying he is faithful and is the king's ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:14 (ESV): "...and who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king's son-in-law..."

questions.question: What did David say to Abiathar about the massacre?
options: I knew on that day... that Doeg... would surely tell Saul. I have occasioned the death...
questions.correctAnswer: I knew on that day... that Doeg... would surely tell Saul. I have occasioned the death...
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 22:22 (ESV): "And David said to Abiathar, 'I knew on that day... I have occasioned the death of all the persons of your father's house.'"

key_verse_text: And everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, gathered to him. And he became captain over them. (ESV)
